[[Private/Legends|Private]] '''Renna''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who served as member of [[Red Hand Squadron]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Like Private [[Joaa'n]], she was muscular and stocky. She participated in the commandeering of the [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] ship [[Emancipator (CR90 corvette)|''Helot's Shackle'']] during the [[Battle of Ylesia]]. She later fought in the [[Battle of Toprawa]] and was eventually killed.
